title: HOI4 Live Tools campaign plan
description: plan.json for the standing-plan executor (native/src/plan_run.rs) and the player. Every top-level key carries x-owner: executor (the executor reads it today) or player (the player acts on it from the brief). x-executor-planned names the build item (coverage audit section 6, W1-n / W2-n) whose executor step takes a player key over; the owner flips to executor when that step lands (x-planned-owner is the older marker). Unknown top-level keys are errors except _-prefixed ones. tests/test_plan_schema.py keeps this file in step with plan_run.rs.

campaign.description: campaign identity; plan_state.json is ignored for another campaign

source.description: who wrote the plan: hand plans get the coverage-build lint rules as warnings (lint_plan.py --hand does the same)

_meta.description: Plan metadata for the strategist and the revision protocol (version is the compare-and-swap key).

_coverage.description: Strategist checklist coverage (coverage audit section 3, items c1..c29): each id maps to key:<plan key>[,<key>...] (an executor or player key of this plan holds the decision), call or call:<key> (a player item with an exact tool call), md:<plan.md section> (text only) or na:<reason> (not applicable, with the reason). Never read by the executor; lint_plan.py coverage.checklist checks it.

x-grammar: string     := comparison | flag | date | ""       ("" holds always)
comparison := name[:arg] op value   (spaces around op optional; op is < <= > >= == !=)
flag       := name[:arg]            (a yes/no atom: x-atoms kind bool; negate with {"not": ...})
date       := YYYY.MM.DD | date:YYYY.MM.DD   (reached; same as date >= YYYY.MM.DD)
value      := number -?D[.D][%] for kind number; a date for kind date; a TAG for kind tag
kind tag   := owner|controller|state_controller:<state>, province_controller:<province> with == or != TAG
(a single = is ==: the older owner:<state>=<TAG> form)
ratio      := atoms with ratio: true are fractions 0..1; a value above 1, or written with %, is a percent
arg        := province|state: digits; tag: [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}; key: [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+; id: [A-Za-z0-9_]+;
branch: army|air|navy (land, naval accepted); army: an army or army_layout name_hint (no < > = !
and no edge spaces); equipment: [A-Za-z0-9_]+; name: [A-Za-z0-9_.@^:]+ (script variable)
evaluation := three-valued: an atom that cannot be read now is unknown, never true, and whatever waits on
it waits; all is false when one part is false, else unknown when one is unknown; any is the
x-atoms    := every atom: kind, arg, min/max, ratio, unit, the read that answers it; readable: false marks
the atoms that are always unknown today (lint predicates.unreadable); legacy_of names the
current atom an older spelling stands for
predicate.description: A check on the game state, as native/src/plan_predicate.rs parses it: a string `atom op value` (ops < <= > >= == !=) or a bare yes/no atom, combined as {"all":[...]}, {"any":[...]}, {"not": p} (a plain list is all). x-grammar is the grammar, x-atoms the atom table; hoi4facts/validate.py parse_predicate implements both.

stability.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent)

war_support.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent)

world_tension.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent)

fuel_ratio.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent): fuel / capacity

resistance.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent)

compliance.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent)

equipment_fill.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent): mean of the army's divisions' lowest fill

vp_share.unit: fraction 0..1 (a value above 1, or with %, is a percent): share of TAG's own victory points TAG still holds

state_fully_controlled.read: hoi4_states: every province held by the player

state_controller.read: hoi4_states: the one tag holding every province

mission_days.unit: days left on a timed mission

capitulated.read: hoi4_wars + hoi4_events + hoi4_states: no longer at war with TAG and (a peace conference is open or TAG owns no state)

call.description: The exact tool call a player-owned item stands for (lint: player items list a tool call).

enabled.description: false switches the war executive off (default on when war is an object)

first.description: false runs the war step after the economy steps (default: war first)

enemies.description: count only while at war with them (hoi4_wars validated)

min_army.description: divisions an army needs to be driven (default 6)

cooldown_hours.description: game hours between orders to one army (default 12)

reserve.description: army names the executor never drives

player_claim_seconds.description: an army the player ordered within this many seconds is left alone (default 300)

axes.description: ordered target state lists; an army follows the axis whose next enemy-held state is nearest

theatre.description: own states an army must stand in to be driven

guard_states.description: the first army standing in such a state guards it

guards.description: army name -> own state it holds (never attacks)

motorization.description: supply trucks level set once on every driven army

stall_days.description: days without progress before a direct move (default 8)

rest_below.description: organisation below which an army rests (default 12)

supply_floor.description: supply percent below which an army rests (default 25)

rest_max_days.description: resume anyway after this many days (default 20)

direct_moves.description: true: direct hoi4_army_move orders instead of battle plans

supply_first.description: false: do not raise supply lines in the construction queue

avoid_pockets.description: false: do not pull encircled armies back

overrides.description: Keys merged over the base plan while a phase or contingency is active (top-level keys replaced, war merged key by key). Executor support is build item 15.

alarms.description: Alarm thresholds (native/src/alarms.rs table); any alarm code set to false is silenced.

army.description: army_layout name_hint or a substring of an army name; empty: any army

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

states.description: state ids, numeric strings or exact state names

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

order.description: done-memory key when the item has no id (plan_run.rs construction_plan_step)

building.description: building key; rail_way or railway uses hoi4_railway_build

path.description: railway: first and last provinces are the end points

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

cap.description: never more than this many divisions of the template fielded plus queued

only_if_stockpile.description: archetype -> equipment the stockpile must hold (a proxy today: training waits while a fielded division lacks that archetype)

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

ref.description: the plan item paid for: template:<templates id>, doctrine:<doctrines id>, design:<id>, spirit:<idea>

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

xp_spends.description: ordered spends of one experience pool (pools cap at 500)

region.description: sea region display name (e.g. 'Eastern North Sea')

sea_region.description: A sea region by its display name as the game's region view shows it, or {region, state_id} with the coastal state hoi4_fleet_region centres to find it.

regions.description: added to the fleet's area first (hoi4_fleet_region)

task_force.description: only this task force (absent: every task force of the fleet)

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

fleet_mission.description: One mission entry of a fleet: per task force the first entry (task_force absent or this one) whose `when` holds is the planned mission; an idle task force always gets it, one on another mission once per entry, reserve task forces never. `state_id` is the coastal state for region orders (default: the fleet entry's, else the fleet's home port state).

amount.description: units, or the trade window's max / needed button

from.description: partner: a tag or the exact name hoi4_trade lists; absent: the partner offering the most units

why.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

note.description: Free text for people and the player; never read by the executor.

trade_deal.description: One manual purchase, made once per id (else resource and partner) through hoi4_trade_set.
